claims: Arrow (2012–2020) is a CW superhero series.
Arrow ran for 8 seasons.
Arrow has 170 episodes.
Arrow stars Stephen Amell.
Arrow follows billionaire Oliver Queen fighting crime as a vigilante.
Arrow spawned the Arrowverse franchise.
The Arrowverse includes The Flash.
The Arrowverse includes Legends of Tomorrow.
Arrow was not canceled due to low ratings.
Arrow concluded at the request of star Stephen Amell and the creators.
Arrow culminated in the Crisis on Infinite Earths crossover event.
Oliver Queen (Green Arrow) fought Slade Wilson (Deathstroke) in Arrow.
Oliver Queen fought Malcolm Merlyn in Arrow.
Oliver Queen fought Ra's al Ghul in Arrow.
Oliver Queen fought Damien Darhk in Arrow.
Oliver Queen fought Prometheus in Arrow.
Oliver Queen fought Ricardo Diaz in Arrow.
Arrow launched the Arrowverse on The CW.
The Arrowverse includes Supergirl.
The Arrowverse includes Batwoman.
The Arrowverse includes Black Lightning.
Arrow was created by Greg Berlanti, Marc Guggenheim, and Andrew Kreisberg.
